summary: FieldSnap Pro v1.4 – all 10 requirements verified. Walkthrough auto-shows on first launch with modal, Skip/Back/Next controls and '1 of 6' text; localStorage flag fsp.walkthroughCompleted is set to true on completion and modal does not reappear on reload. Replay Tutorial resets the flag (verified as 'false' after tap) and navigates home where the modal re-appears. Settings shows all required sections (APP, HELP & SUPPORT, INFORMATION) in addition to LOCATION, COMPANY INFO, WATERMARK, APPEARANCE, SECURITY, OBSERVATIONS, and every required testID is present (rate-app-button, share-app-button, replay-tutorial-button, open-help-faq, send-feedback-button, open-about, open-privacy-policy, settings-gps-toggle, template-A..D, company/project/auditor-name-input, wm-*, theme-*, settings-pin-toggle, reset-counter-button). /help renders 'Help & FAQ' with all 12 FAQ cards including the required three. /about renders 'FieldSnap Pro', 'Version 1.4.0', package 'com.emergent.fielddocs.mztrm', developer name and about-open-privacy link. Source review of editor.tsx confirms: no editor-redo-button anywhere, header order is close → title → zoom-reset → undo → header-save (save now occupies Redo's former last position), and undo() explicitly resets markerCounterRef.current to 0 (line 407). Rate uses Linking with MARKET_URL then web fallback; Share uses RN Share.share with SHARE_MESSAGE which contains the Play Store URL and NO image URI reference; Feedback opens mailto with subject 'FieldSnap Pro – User Feedback' and body containing APP_VERSION and Platform. Existing obs-export-button still calls Sharing.shareAsync(obs.imageUri). No runtime errors on Home/Settings/Help/About/Privacy routes.

issues: Footer text at end of Settings still reads 'FieldSnap Pro • v1.1' (settings.tsx:318) while APP_VERSION is 1.4.0 — cosmetic version mismatch

action_items: Cosmetic: update the hard-coded 'FieldSnap Pro • v1.1' string in /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx (line 318) to use APP_VERSION from src/constants.ts so it reads 1.4.0.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx renders <Walkthrough /> without a forceOpen prop, so Settings → Replay Tutorial relies on resetWalkthrough() + router.replace('/'). Because Home is already mounted, useFocusEffect re-runs but Walkthrough's useEffect only runs once on mount – it still works here because router.replace('/') remounts the Home screen, which was verified live (modal re-appeared and flag flipped to 'false'). If replace() ever gets swapped for router.back(), the tutorial replay will silently fail; consider passing an explicit forceOpen state from Home.
settings.tsx line 318 hard-codes 'v1.1' — should reference APP_VERSION constant.
Deprecation warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — originates from RN Web (View pointerEvents prop). Non-blocking but worth migrating.
